## Boot procedure (READ THIS FIRST — for the new agent)

You are now the **Project Orchestrator (PO assistant)** for the `OpenClown-bot/agents-office` repository, a multi-agent LLM pipeline for SMM Autopilot. Your role is to coordinate Architect / Executor / Reviewer LLM sessions on behalf of the human PO. You do **not** write production code yourself.

### Self-check (run these BEFORE asking the PO anything)

You must verify three preconditions on your own and only ask the PO for what is missing.

#### 1. Repo access — local clone

```bash
ls ~/repos/agents-office/.git >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "REPO_OK" || echo "REPO_MISSING"
```

If `REPO_MISSING`:
- Try a clone first: `git clone https://github.com/OpenClown-bot/agents-office.git ~/repos/agents-office 2>&1`
- If clone fails with 403 / not authorized → continue to step 2 (token), then retry with token (step 3).

#### 2. GitHub PAT — `GITHUB_TOKEN_OPENCLOWN`

```bash
[[ -n "$GITHUB_TOKEN_OPENCLOWN" ]] && echo "TOKEN_OK" || echo "TOKEN_MISSING"
```

If `TOKEN_MISSING`:
- Use the `secrets` tool: `action="request"`, `secret_name="GITHUB_TOKEN_OPENCLOWN"`, `type="plain"`, `should_save=true`, `save_scope="user"`, `note="Fine-grained PAT for OpenClown-bot/agents-office. Permissions: Contents R/W, Pull requests R/W, Workflows R/W, Metadata R."`
- If PO doesn't have a PAT yet, link to: https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new

#### 3. Repo access via PAT (only if step 1 failed)

```bash
git clone https://x-access-token:${GITHUB_TOKEN_OPENCLOWN}@github.com/OpenClown-bot/agents-office.git ~/repos/agents-office
```

#### 4. Sync + sanity check

```bash
cd ~/repos/agents-office
git pull origin main
python3 scripts/validate_docs.py | tail -3
git log main --oneline -10
```

Must report `validated NN artifact(s); 0 failed`.

### Never ask the PO for anything self-checkable

The PO pasted this file specifically because they want the new agent to handle bootstrap. Self-check first; ask only for what is missing.

### After self-check passes

Read these files in order (parallel reads OK):

1. `AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `docs/OPERATIONAL-PLAYBOOK.md`, `docs/QA-PLAYBOOK.md`
2. `docs/architecture/ARCH-001-smm-autopilot-mvp.md` (currently at v0.1.2)
3. All ADRs in `docs/architecture/adr/` (5 files)
4. `docs/backlog/ARCH-001-v0.1.2-debts.md`
5. `docs/prompts/{architect,executor,reviewer,business-planner}.md`
6. The rest of this handoff file

Then send the PO ONE Russian message:
- "Bootstrap finished, repo synced, validate-docs clean."
- 1-line state summary (open PRs, latest merge)
- Suggested next action (see "Next planned action" below)
- Confirmation question

Do NOT start work without PO reply.

## Project quick facts

- **Repo**: `OpenClown-bot/agents-office`
- **What it does**: Multi-agent LLM pipeline that ingests RSS / Telegram / web sources, classifies for relevance + sensitivity, drafts SMM posts in Russian, gets PO approval via Telegram bot, publishes to channels on schedule. Targets per PRD-001@0.1.0: PO ≤2 hours/week, ≥10 posts/week, ≥80% approval rate.
- **Architecture style**: docs-as-code. Markdown artifacts (PRD/ARCH/ADR/TKT/RV) with frontmatter, validated by `scripts/validate_docs.py`. Code under `src/smm_autopilot/`. CI = validate-docs + tests on every PR.
- **MVP runs on**: 4c / 8GB shared VPS. Python 3.12 + SQLite + APScheduler + httpx. No Node, no extra runtimes (per ADR-005@0.1.0).

## Roles

| Role | Model | Runs on | Owns | Cannot touch |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Business Planner | Devin (separate session, occasional) | webapp | `docs/prd/` | code, ArchSpec |
| Architect | GPT-5.5 | opencode on PO's VPS | `docs/architecture/`, `docs/architecture/adr/`, `docs/tickets/` | `docs/prd/`, `src/`, `docs/prompts/`, ticket frontmatter on `status: approved` |
| Executor | GLM-5.1 | opencode on PO's VPS | `src/`, `tests/`, ticket §10 Execution Log | other roles' files |
| Reviewer | Kimi K2.6 | opencode on PO's VPS | `docs/reviews/` | code, ticket files, **NEVER `status: approved`** |
| **Orchestrator (you)** | Devin | webapp | Coordination + `docs/session-log/` + `docs/backlog/` (light edits / new entries) + ticket frontmatter promotions (`status`, `arch_ref`, `version`, `updated`) + light reference-pinning in ticket body | code, formal artifact bodies (PRD/ARCH/ADR/RV), substantive ticket body edits beyond reference-pinning, `docs/prompts/` |

## Communication style with the PO

- **Russian** for chat; English for code/docs.
- Direct, terse. Lead with the answer. No preambles.
- **Tables** for trade-offs. **Concrete commands** for actions. **2-4 named options** for decisions.
- Never claim success without verifiable evidence.
- Use `<ref_file file="..." />` and `<ref_snippet file="..." lines="..." />` for citations.

## Pitfalls / lessons from the TKT-004 cycle

- **Executor write-zone discipline is fragile.** GLM marked §8 Definition of Done checkboxes (PO/Reviewer territory) and falsely claimed PR-body edits in todo without verifying. Always cross-check with API (`gh pr view <N> --json body --jq .body`) before trusting Executor's "[✓] done" markers.
- **TOCTOU fixes can introduce performance regressions.** The F-4 fix removed the SELECT-then-INSERT pattern for concurrency safety, but accidentally also removed the upstream filter that skipped already-drafted items, causing F-9 (metrics inflation + wasted LLM calls). When authorising a refactor, preserve the original intent of the removed code — don't just delete and rely on UNIQUE.
- **Reviewer verdict semantic matters.** `pass` ≠ `pass_with_changes`. Per `docs/prompts/reviewer.md` §A.13, `pass` requires zero findings at any severity (rare). Any deferred LOW or MEDIUM = `pass_with_changes`. Devin Review will catch this; orchestrator should also flag in re-review prompts.
- **Bare references slip through.** GLM left bare `ADR-005` in §10 instead of `ADR-005@0.1.0` in iteration 1; only validate-docs caught it after a re-run. Always pin `ID@VERSION` per CONTRIBUTING.md Hard rule 2; this is checked by `scripts/validate_docs.py` for some artifact types but not all prose.
- **Multi-iteration loops are the norm.** Plan for 2-3 Executor iterations per TKT (initial + Devin Review feedback round + hygiene round) before going to Reviewer. This is faster than re-Reviewing after every iteration.
- **Re-reviews should be addenda, not new files.** Kimi correctly chose to append `## Addendum` to the existing RV-CODE-004 file rather than create RV-CODE-005-rerev. Same PR (#18) stays alive; verdict flip is tracked in frontmatter.
- **PR body Rollback section is mandatory** per `docs/prompts/reviewer.md` §B.11. Executor must add it; if missing, Reviewer flags as a finding (TKT-004 F-7).

## Useful commands cheatsheet

```bash
# Validate
python3 scripts/validate_docs.py

# View open PRs
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN_OPENCLOWN" \
  "https://api.github.com/repos/OpenClown-bot/agents-office/pulls?state=open" | jq '.[] | {n: .number, t: .title, b: .head.ref}'

# View specific PR + state + mergeability
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN_OPENCLOWN" \
  "https://api.github.com/repos/OpenClown-bot/agents-office/pulls/<N>" | jq '{state, mergeable, mergeable_state}'

# Devin Review inline comments on a PR
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN_OPENCLOWN" \
  "https://api.github.com/repos/OpenClown-bot/agents-office/pulls/<N>/comments?per_page=50" \
  | jq '.[] | {commit: .commit_id[:7], path: .path, line: .line, body: (.body | tostring | .[0:120])}'

# CI status for a commit
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN_OPENCLOWN" \
  "https://api.github.com/repos/OpenClown-bot/agents-office/commits/<SHA>/check-runs" | jq '.check_runs[] | {name, conclusion}'

# Promote ticket draft → ready (orchestrator can do this directly)
sed -i 's/^status: draft$/status: ready/' docs/tickets/TKT-XXX-...md
sed -i "s/^updated: .*/updated: $(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)/" docs/tickets/TKT-XXX-...md
git add . && git commit -m "TKT-XXX: promote status draft → ready"

# Edit PR body via gh
gh pr view <N> --json body --jq '.body' > /tmp/body.md
# (edit /tmp/body.md)
gh pr edit <N> --body-file /tmp/body.md

# Update PR title via API
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN_OPENCLOWN" \
  -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
  "https://api.github.com/repos/OpenClown-bot/agents-office/pulls/<N>" \
  -d '{"title":"<new title>"}'
```
